plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Nothing in the plan shows the category rule (C3), because it is reserved to the requester and the library has no instrument for it. I would have wanted a check of the live tables after the promotion. Same set and summary of the change read only the staged set. Clauses C5 and C10 can be shown only by scope of a call and trace of a call, which are taken on named lines during the work and are paid from the allowance. I will ask for them once the record exists, on the lines that are in doubt.
